title: Hosted release commits do not start exact-source development CI
surface: Hosted release and current-source development artifact
severity: S2: released main can lack its own verified development artifact
priority: P1: make release-triggered CI produce exact-source evidence
preconditions: Hosted release pushes main and immutable tag using its checkout token.
reproduction: GitHub Actions API returns zero CI workflow runs for release commits e39cedba10360c57135dd937b19a3ad5509504e3 and 6adb65d53f1b8047545c1361fb0fdfd9455a1016; 6adb65d53 has hosted release run 39659073385.
Nearby human main pushes 5eb78e8aa559450cd92475989f349c3705843059 and 7a4c1e50d25a25016c94afa26915a82adac90c63 have push CI runs.
expected: A successful hosted release creates an exact-source CI development artifact through the full public CI checks when its commit remains main.
actual: The GitHub-token release push does not trigger ci.yml, leaving no CI run at the release SHA.
cause: release.yml persists its GITHUB_TOKEN checkout credentials; release.sh pushes with them, and GitHub suppresses downstream push workflow runs from GITHUB_TOKEN events.
reproducibility: Exact GitHub Actions API and release workflow/source inspection confirm both observed release commits lack a CI run.
next_action: Push reviewed scope-gate repair, observe successful exact-main fullCI development artifact, normal import/promotion and owner Chrome Reload; then normal D217 acceptance. Keep D282 fixed until original bot-release→CI path independently passes.
